title: Let native training packs choose episodes up to 32 s
summary: locomotion.spark.prepare and the native training script (scripts/cli.py) accepted training episodes of 5 to 20 s; both now accept up to 32 s, the evaluator's longest probe, so destination_v28 and destination_v29 can train their 32 s stands natively. scripts/train.py already requires each named experiment's own episode length, and the native environment allows up to 60 s. The first native destination_v29 launch stopped in cli.py's check before training.
next: Queue the destination_v29 fine-tune of the native destination_v25 update-1350 checkpoint on the Spark.
reason: Only training packs that ask for a longer episode change; the default 20 s pack, the canonical task, reward and evaluator are unchanged.
